verdict.rationale: The only evidence of availability visibility is one community report that Runpod shows 'low availability' messages when deploying 4090s. That is a product-surfaced capacity signal, but it is thin, and the same user says instances sometimes still fail to boot. The docs list '30+ regions' but never describe an availability view, API or CLI query. Missing for 10: documented real-time availability by GPU type, a per-region availability breakdown, a programmatic API/CLI availability query, and evidence that the signal reliably prevents provisioning failures.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure

citations.quote: Now when I want to deploy my model, I get 'low availability' messages and sometimes the instance doesn't even boot up correctly.
